name: Un tren a ninguna parte
source:
A near future shrouded in shadows. A terrorist attack in the subway tunnels. Two suspects.

Put yourself in the shoes of Sergeant Miriam Mola and try to get information from the two possible suspects!

[From [url=https://navi-0.itch.io/un-tren-a-ninguna-parte]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不久的将来笼罩在阴影之中。地铁隧道内发生恐怖袭击。两名嫌疑人。

设身处地为米里亚姆·莫拉中士着想，尝试从两名可能的嫌疑人那里获取信息！

[来自[url=https://navi-0.itch.io/un-tren-a-ninguna-parte]itch.io[/url]]
